page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support data transfer requirements. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high resource density of the ecs.g7.32xlarge position it for enterprise-scale workloads that require consistent CPU performance without hyperthreading interference. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and distributed database nodes that do not require local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
